changes.title: Man describes harrowing escape from wildfire that killed wife and friends
changes.summary: A last minute decision meant Malcolm Timbrell survived one of Spain's deadliest wildfires ever, but his wife and friends were trapped by a wall of flames.

changes.summary: Many say communication was chaotic and even nonexistent as flames tore through the area, taking 12 lives in one of the deadliest wildfires on record in Spain.

changes.title: This English professor has run with the bulls in Spain for two decades
changes.summary: When Bill Hillmann was 19 years old, he read Ernest Hemingway's The Sun Also Rises . That book inspired him to pursue two dreams: a career in literature and to run with the bulls in Pamplona, Spain.

changes.title: Poll: Patriotism in the US, Europe and Canada, charted
changes.summary: What does it mean to be patriotic? It depends on a country's politics. Pride in one’s country is itself relatively common, according to new results from an international edition of The POLITICO Poll: Majorities of adults across the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, Canada, France and Germany all say they are proud.

changes.title: One of Spain's deadliest wildfires has killed at least 11 people
changes.summary: A wildfire in southern Spain has killed at least 11 people, making it one of the country's deadliest on record, as soaring temperatures grip much of the country. (Image credit: INFOCA).
